title: How to Find Fair Compensation with Kahran & Divya
summary: Kahran and Divya wander from tornado-chasing and the unwalkability of Bangalore into the real question — how do you weigh a job or a life decision when straight compensation isn't the only thing being paid? Kahran reflects on leaving tech for culinary school at 30, his upcoming MFA, and a friend in the UK who works four-hour days. They land on how 'just good enough' outcomes are more dangerous than bad ones because they keep you out of touch with what you actually want.
topics: weighing a job by your whole life
taking a sabbatical for culinary school
growth vs lifestyle for a company

intents.display: to think about compensation beyond the paycheck when weighing a job
